description: The providers that can write dynamic DNS records

credential_provider.description: ID of the DNS credential provider whose saved credential it uses; null for the custom provider, which has none

proxied.description: Whether it has a proxied flag NPMpro reads and never changes

admin_only.description: Whether only administrators may use it

wildcards.description: Whether a wildcard record name (`*.example.com`) is allowed

aliases.description: Whether an alias (CNAME) record is allowed

zoneless.description: Whether the provider has no zones and no record read (DuckDNS): records are address records only, take no TTL and sit under its one fixed zone

zone.description: The fixed zone of a zoneless provider (`duckdns.org`: the record name is `<subdomain>.duckdns.org`); null for the others

apex.description: Whether a record at the zone apex is allowed

min_ttl.description: The lowest TTL in seconds the provider takes; a record's TTL below it is refused. Null when the provider documents none
